About

Where ideas hit top speed

ASCEND 2026 is a two-day event series by the IETE Student Forum, Maharashtra Institute of Technology, Chhatrapati Sambhaji Nagar. It pairs technical and competitive events with activities that build confidence, leadership and fitness, so every student finds a place to compete, learn and work with peers from other departments.

Hands-on circuits, bots on a track, a parliament floor, a cricket box and an e-sports arena: five events, one finish line.
